Figure 7: Overview of the proposed LF-IBIS algorithm. Starting from an initial approximation of the posterior distribution, the algorithm iteratively performs either an SMC-ABC step, in which the ABC tolerance is adaptively reduced, or an IBIS step, in which newly observed data are incorporated through likelihood-free importance reweighting. When necessary, particles are resampled and rejuvenated via an MCMC move. The resulting particles provide an approximation of the posterior distribution over model parameters and optimal policies.
